desc: Derive and confirm the structural formula: even N -> f(whole array); odd N -> max over odd 1-indexed survivor of f(left even prefix) + f(right even suffix), where f(even multiset) = sum(largest half) - sum(smallest half).

Implement and validate the complete Python solution using the two-heaps prefix/suffix method: prefix_f half-indexed, even/odd combination, O(N log N) time, O(N) memory, 64-bit integer arithmetic, samples plus small brute-force validation.
Verify sample tests pass and confirm the current implementation is ready for submission.
